arguments.command:
cd /app/tmp && python3 -I /app/submission/main.py < /app/examples/requests.jsonl && echo "--- size check ---" && python3 -c "
import os
tot = 0
for root, dirs, files in os.walk('/app/submission'):
    for f in files:
        p = os.path.join(root,f)
        print(p, os.path.getsize(p), oct(os.stat(p).st_mode)[-3:])
        tot += os.path.getsize(p)
print('total bytes', tot, 'limit', 1024*1024, 'ok', tot <= 1024*1024)
"
